items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview

ctx.x: A guy called me, Milt Mackler(?), who was a friend of mine, who I used to go in the Village and hang out with -- a White boy. He was a friend of the guy that owned the Gaslight Club, the manager. I can't think of that man's name. He said, "Danny, I've got a good job for you." I said, "What is that?" Milt said, "At the Gaslight Club." "Well, I'm working." I didn't know nothin' about what's happening at the Gaslight Club. He said, "They want a banjo player." I said, "I can't make it. I got this gig" -- or whatever…
